SINGLE-PLAYER + MULTIPLAYER
UNREAL ENGINE 5.7 // C++

// WIP — ARTWORK PENDING

A GAME OF MY OWN

Creating my childhood dream.

Voidstar is my personal single-player and multiplayer spaceship game, built in Unreal Engine 5.7 with C++.

It started off as me learning the Network Prediction Plugin and ended up as a fully fledged game, inspired by my childhood favorite game: Freelancer.

UNDER THE HOOD

The systems behind the game.

A look at the technical foundations.
↗

01 // FLIGHT

Client-predicted movement

Third-person space combat with movement and rotation across all axes. Custom physics sub-stepping supports high-velocity flight.

MOVEMENT // PHYSICS
⌘

02 // NETWORKING

Gameplay Ability System

Custom client-predicted projectiles built alongside GAS, ensuring multiplayer gameplay feels smooth regardless of ping.

GAS // CLIENT PREDICTION
✳

03 // SINGLEPLAYER

The core systems

Custom world graph for the star map. Traffic simulation for AIs out of range. Commerce system to make the world feel alive.
